string.name: jump_page_subtitle
string.value: Launch other apps with startAbility. Success, rejection and 3-second timeout are all written to the log.

string.name: jump_impl_desc
string.value: Jump uses UIAbilityContext.startAbility with an explicit Want. Three built-in targets are settings, this app's home page and an uninstalled app, covering the success, success and 16000001 error branches. Each attempt gets a new token; no result within 3 seconds is treated as timeout and late callbacks are dropped by token.

string.name: jump_msg_timeout
string.value: %s did not respond within %d seconds; timeout

string.name: download_page_subtitle
string.value: A download button with a unified style. It prefers the document picker and falls back to the app sandbox when unavailable.

string.name: download_impl_desc
string.value: DownloadFileButton only provides the unified button style; the click behavior is implemented by the generic onClick. The sample uses picker.DocumentViewPicker in DOWNLOAD mode to get the public downloads directory; if the board image has no file picker, it writes to the app sandbox filesDir and shows the real path.

string.name: half_page_subtitle
string.value: Launch an atomic service with half-screen embedding. A placeholder appId is used, so the board follows the onError fallback path.

string.name: half_trigger_title
string.value: Tap to trigger a launch test

string.name: half_trigger_hint
string.value: Placeholder appId · onError is expected; result shown below

string.name: half_stub_desc
string.value: Embedded launch requires the target atomic service to have an AGC-assigned appId and its ability to extend EmbeddableUIAbility. An offline board has neither, so this shows the real onError fallback. For a real service, replace the appId and ensure it supports embedded launch; otherwise the system falls back to a pop-up launch.

string.name: half_result_error
string.value: Launch failed (%d): %s. The placeholder appId cannot be resolved on an offline board, which is expected.

string.name: nav_page_subtitle
string.value: The app's outer container is this component. Settings below apply live to this page's title bar, background and navigation mode.

string.name: prefs_page_subtitle
string.value: Use preferences to write, read, delete and clear; data is flushed to disk and restored after restart.

string.name: prefs_hint
string.value: Up to %d characters; leading and trailing whitespace is trimmed

string.name: prefs_impl_desc
string.value: The preferences instance is created by preferences.getPreferencesSync; writes and deletes use the sync APIs followed by flush. The read counter accumulates with each write and is persisted together, then restored when the page opens.

string.name: search_page_subtitle
string.value: The search area, selector and two action areas are combined; all interactions are written to the log below.

string.name: search_input_placeholder
string.value: Enter a component name or category

string.name: sheet_page_subtitle
string.value: Use bindSheet for half-modal content with height detents, style switching and close callbacks.

string.name: sheet_content_desc
string.value: Drag up to switch between medium and large detents; drag down past the threshold or tap close to exit.

string.name: sheet_impl_desc
string.value: bindSheet uses $$ two-way binding; detents are medium and large; preferType switches between CENTER and POPUP. onHeightDidChange logs the drag height bucketed as low/medium/high, and onDisappear records the close reason.

string.name: tabs_page_subtitle
string.value: Three icon-text tabs demonstrating tap, switch, switch interception and layout mode.

string.name: tabs_overview_desc
string.value: AtomicServiceTabs keeps the Tabs switching capability while simplifying tab styles, supporting up to 5 tabs.

string.name: tabs_data_desc
string.value: After switching, the onChange callback updates the current index; counts come from records with source=Tabs in the global log store.

string.name: tabs_more_desc
string.value: When tabs are locked, onContentWillChange returns false and switching is intercepted.

string.name: web_page_subtitle
string.value: Loads local rawfile pages that can navigate between each other, with controller forward/back/refresh and H5 messages.

string.name: web_local_desc
string.value: The pages are resources/rawfile/index.html and page2.html and do not need the network. They can navigate to each other; back/forward switch pages in history and onPageBegin/onPageEnd log it. The Send message button in H5 calls the JS SDK injected by AtomicServiceWeb; if no JS SDK is injected, the page shows a status hint instead of crashing.
